title: Ohm Brew Slush Brew Red Mix 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Red Mix from Ohm Brew’s Slush Brew collection is a tongue-tingling slushy flavour with the fresh, summery-sweetness of strawberry. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mods and sub-ohm tanks .
